name: contextbase
description: ContextBase long-term memory for AI agents with retain, recall and reflect.

contextbase.memory.bankSelection: Set CONTEXTBASE_BANK_ID; the bank is sent as X-Bank-Id.
contextbase.memory.endpoint: Set mcp.json url to the endpoint provided by your service administrator before installation.
contextbase.memory.codex: For Codex, build the coding-agents package and run contextbase-coding-agents install codex.
